description: Defines classes for MPEG descriptor parsing, including Descriptor and DescriptorIterator, within the Thunder::Broadcast::MPEG namespace.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Represents an MPEG descriptor with methods to access tag, length, and data.

classes.name: DescriptorIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing multiple MPEG descriptors within a data block.

methods.name: Descriptor(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs a Descriptor from a data element.

methods.name: Tag()
methods.description: Returns the tag of the descriptor.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the descriptor data.

methods.name: operator[](const uint8_t index)
methods.description: Accesses data byte at specified index within the descriptor.

methods.name: DescriptorIterator(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs an iterator over descriptors in data.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the iterator to initial state.

methods.name: Tag(const uint8_t tagId)
methods.description: Finds a descriptor with the specified tag.
